lead.description: the extent to which observations are accurate for the quantities they record and representative for the population they describe

overview_sentence: [Data quality](articles/data-quality.qmd) is the fitness of observations for the quantities and the population they are asked to represent.

self_checks.title: Bias of the mean
self_checks.prompt: Readings 22, 23, 21, and 22 are taken on a true length of 20. What is the bias of their mean?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 22, so the bias is 2.

self_checks.title: Fifth reading
self_checks.prompt: A fifth reading of 24 is added, and the true length stays 20. What is the bias of the new mean?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 22.4, so the bias is 2.4.
